generate_audio_from_text: generate audio from text prompts using MusicgenMelodyForConditionalGeneration with text encoder and audio encoder conditioning
build_delay_pattern_mask: build a delayed pattern mask to offset each codebook prediction by one for multi-codebook autoregressive audio generation
apply_delay_pattern_mask: apply a delay pattern mask to decoder input ids preserving predictions where mask is set to -1
create_conditional_generation_model: create a MusicgenMelodyForConditionalGeneration model from pretrained text encoder, audio encoder, and decoder sub-models
freeze_encoder_weights: freeze audio encoder or text encoder weights for fine-tuning the decoder only in MusicgenMelodyForConditionalGeneration
